purpose.domain_detail: Brazilian payroll IRRF (Imposto de Renda Retido na Fonte) income tax withholding calculation on net salary
purpose.summary: This subprogram calculates the net salary (salário líquido) by applying Brazilian IRRF income tax brackets to a reference salary. It determines the applicable tax rate and deduction based on five IRRF brackets, computes the IRRF discount, then subtracts it from the reference salary to produce the net salary.

notable_features: LINKAGE SECTION with PROCEDURE DIVISION USING — called as subprogram
DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA with comma-decimal numeric literals
88-level condition names for IRRF tax brackets
EXIT PROGRAM to return to caller
No COPY statements, no EXEC SQL/CICS
Brazilian tax law IRRF brackets (2023 table)
verdict.notes: File is a student exercise dated 20/11/2023 by a named Brazilian author. The use of DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA and comma-separated numeric literals is standard Brazilian GnuCOBOL practice. The 88-level VALUE ranges use comma as decimal point (e.g. VALUE 2112,01 THRU 2826,65). No truncation detected; all 4 divisions present and complete.
